'''Largetto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Alien/Legends|non-humanoid]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]. He had big glossy eyes.

==Biography==
Largetto was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Senator that represented a beset [[Planet/Legends|world]] that was some distance from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]. Along with his fellow Senators, [[Des'sein]] and [[Fang Zar/Legends|Fang Zar]], Largetto was a member of the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]].

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Largetto was one of the members of the Republic Group present to received a package from [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tobb Jadak|Jadak]]. The package was said to have contained information that was crucial to the Republic Group's cause. Just after the end of the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], Largetto was told by Zang Far that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had been rescued from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] custody, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] had been [[Death/Legends|defeated]] and that martial law on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had ended. Largetto rejoiced at the news but was quickly sobered by Des'sein who believed the Republic Group needed to proceed with their plans. At that point in time Largetto told Captain Jadak that he should deliver the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Stellar Envoy'']] to [[Antarian Rangers/Legends|Antarian Ranger]] [[Aren Folee]] in [[Salik City]] on [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]]. He then provided the mnemonic code,''"Restore Republic honor to the galaxy"'', that Jadak was to say to Folee upon delivery. With the ''Stellar Envoy'' and the mnemonic code Folee would then be able to retrieve the Republic Group's [[Insignia of Unity|treasure]].

In [[43 ABY]], Largetto's mnemonic device was used by the [[Solo family/Legends|Solos]] and Jadak to travel to [[Tandun III]] where they found the Republic Group's treasure.
